_comment: Maps each doc_key the extractor can emit to a source in the database. type=static -> copy the file as-is. type=template -> fill placeholders from company profile + tender data. type=manual -> we can't auto-produce it; flag it for the user.

pqc_document.note: Provide either authorization certificate OR a past PO (last 3 yrs) to a PSU/govt with COC from OEM.

signed_buyer_spec.note: Download buyer specification from the bid, sign & stamp each page, upload as seller specification.

boq_compliance.note: Fill the BoQ compliance statement against each line item; needs engineering sign-off.

hsn_gst_excel.note: Fill HSN code + GST% in the buyer's provided excel template (no price in technical bid).

warranty_certificate.note: Submitted at delivery, not at bid stage. Listed for tracking only.

annexure_f.note: Payment Annexure-F submitted to paying authority after dispatch, not at bid stage.

additional_doc_1_requested_in_atc.note: Payment Annexure-F submitted to paying authority after dispatch, not at bid stage.

compliance_of_boq_specification_and_supp.note: Fill the BoQ compliance statement against each line item; needs engineering sign-off.
